cause: Supabase Data API/PostgREST internal pool timeouts (PGRST003), then unavailable schema cache (PGRST002). Account entitlement lookups returned 504 although Auth/password validation and direct SQL worked.
recovery: Existing free project paused and resumed to restart the failed Data API after config/schema reload and a narrowly scoped idle-connection reset did not recover it. No new project, schema rollback or writing/activity mutation.

browserSuites: login destinations and four session recovery scenarios
Google OAuth callbacks and account/cache boundaries

limits: Production recovery was verified through public APIs, provider health and metadata. No customer password, private live sign-in, paid-model call or email send was used.
